description: ArcFlattening.samplePoints/sampleBulgePoints/computeSampleCount and EllipseFlattening.samplePoints (the real production namespace-object exports) evaluated over a deliberate radius/sweep/rotation/degenerate input matrix plus real DXF-fixture-derived curves (tests/fixtures/dxf/circle-ellipse-arcs.dxf, tests/fixtures/dxf/rounded-rectangle.dxf, and two hand-authored-but-really-parsed entities mirroring tests/unit/dxfSourceFlattening.test.ts). f64 values are plain JSON numbers for ordinary finite values and tagged strings ("0"/"-0"/"NaN"/"Infinity"/"-Infinity") otherwise, matching dump-canonical-grid.ts's encodeF64 convention (both JSON.stringify/JSON.parse and serde_json[float_roundtrip] round-trip plain finite JSON numbers bit-exactly).
